name: Stack of press clippings
purpose: Build a stack of editable source articles and highlight a headline
notes: Image paths are relative to the folder holding the overrides file. Fewer images than the layout has: they repeat. Keys marked required have no usable sample figure and must be supplied. Text may use "|" as a line break where the sample does.

title.default: WHY FEARS OF A SAMPLE MARKET BUBBLE ARE GROWING

body.default: Observers are looking closely at the rapid growth of a made-up industry. Fresh products have attracted large sums, and some experts worry about what comes next.
